title: Console: changelog view + API for route config diffs (incl. quantization settings)
author: Jada Williams
release_notes: Console: Added Route Settings changelog endpoint and UI support to view who changed route config (including quantization_profile_ref) and when, with human-readable diffs and RBAC enforcement.
description:
Summary
Adds change history (changelog) support for route configuration updates, with first-class diff rendering for quantization profile settings. This enables Console to display "who changed quant settings and when" and supports audit/compliance workflows without requiring customers to query raw audit logs.

Context
We already emit structured audit events for quantization setting changes (see pr-18503). However, Console lacked a read API and view model to show:
- timeline of changes per route
- actor identity (user/service) + source (Console/API)
- a compact before/after diff for relevant fields (quantization_profile_ref, enable/disable, and compatibility/fallback outcomes)

This PR adds:
1) A new read endpoint used by Console backend: GET /v1/routes/{route_id}/changelog
2) Diff computation + redaction rules for sensitive fields
3) A small view-model layer to produce stable, human-readable diffs in the UI

What’s included
- Change history endpoint (paginated) backed by audit events + route config revisions
- Deterministic diff generation for a subset of route config:
  - quantization_profile_ref: default -> profile:<id>
  - quantization_profile_state: disabled/enabled
  - optional scoping fields (region/tier) when present
- Actor + authn details:
  - actor_type: user | service
  - actor_id (stable)
  - display_name (best-effort)
  - request_id + source (console|api|migration)
- RBAC: requires RouteSettings.ReadAudit (same permission tier as viewing audit logs in Console)
- Redaction policy:
  - show only field names + normalized values (no tokens/secrets)
  - no request payload echo
  - do not expose internal policy-engine debug strings

What’s not included
- Export (CSV/SIEM) from Console (tracked separately)
- Full diff coverage across every route field; we currently scope to fields Console edits + quantization settings for v1

API example
GET /v1/routes/rt_8f3a.../changelog?limit=50&cursor=...
Returns entries ordered newest-first. Each entry contains timestamp, actor, source, and a list of rendered diffs (e.g. "quantization_profile_ref: default → profile:qpl_mistral7b_int8_v3").

Implementation notes
- Data source:
  - Primary: audit_log_events where event_type in [route.config.updated, route.quant_profile.updated]
  - Fallback: route_config_revisions for older revisions without rich audit payload (best-effort; diff only for supported fields)
- Diff semantics:
  - Only emits diffs for recognized keys to avoid leaking unknown/new config payloads by accident
  - Values normalized to stable strings so UI doesn’t churn (e.g. profile refs canonicalized)
- Performance:
  - Cursor-based pagination (created_at + id)
  - index added on (route_id, created_at desc)

Testing
- Unit tests for diff renderer (including default->profile, profile->default, enable/disable)
- RBAC coverage: unauthorized returns 403 with consistent error code
- Integration test: writes route setting change, then reads changelog and asserts rendered diff + actor

Rollout
- Safe to deploy dark; Console will call endpoint behind feature flag CONSOLE_ROUTE_CHANGELOG
- No behavior change for route config writes

Follow-ups
- Add export fields requested in INT-9170 (actor_id, route_id, quant_profile_id) to audit log exporter pipeline
- Expand diff coverage to traffic splitting and fallback policies once those are editable in Console

Refs
- pr-18496 (Console backend endpoints for route quant settings)
- pr-18503 (audit log events for quant profile changes)
- pr-18618 (user-facing errors for incompatibility; changelog will display those states once the UI is wired)

Checklist
- [x] Added endpoint documentation in service README
- [x] Added tests (unit + integration)
- [x] Confirmed redaction policy with Security/Compliance (Naomi)
- [x] Confirmed audit log event compatibility (Kevin)
- [x] Verified pagination and query plans
commits: console(changelog): add route changelog read endpoint wired to audit events
console(changelog): implement diff renderer for quantization fields + normalization
rbac: require RouteSettings.ReadAudit permission for changelog access
db: add index for route_id + created_at for changelog queries
tests: add integration coverage for route config update -> changelog entry
review_conversation:
Chloe Martin (review): Can we avoid returning raw audit payloads to the UI? We should only return a sanitized view model. Also, pagination cursor should be stable (created_at + id), not just offset.

Jada Williams (author): Agreed. Updated implementation to build a RouteChangelogEntryView with only actor/time/source + rendered diffs. Switched to cursor pagination (created_at, id) and added tests.

Naomi Feldman (review): Redaction: please confirm we never show request bodies or policy debug strings. Also, for actor identity, do we leak internal emails?

Jada Williams (author): Added explicit allowlist for diff keys and value normalization. Actor display_name is best-effort and uses the existing "public display" field (no emails). When unavailable we show actor_id and actor_type.

Kevin Osei (review): INT-9170 wants audit export fields; this endpoint shouldn’t become the exporter. But make sure changelog entries include stable actor_id + route_id + event_id for traceability.

Jada Williams (author): Included event_id + request_id in the view model (not displayed in UI by default, but available to Console for deep links). Not touching exporter in this PR.

Ethan Park (review): Query plan looks okay but audit table can be hot. Can you add an index and cap limit to 200?

Jada Williams (author): Added composite index on (route_id, created_at desc) and hard-capped limit to 200; default 50.

Dylan Brooks (approval): This matches the UX mock needs. Please ensure feature flag name is consistent with other Route Settings flags.

Jada Williams (author): Renamed flag to CONSOLE_ROUTE_CHANGELOG to match existing naming.
